about.name: Nikolay Kostov
about.title: Senior Cloud Engineer & DevOps Specialist
about.summary: Cloud engineer with over 8 years of experience building scalable, reliable systems, specializing in cloud infrastructure, container orchestration, and DevOps practices.
story: My path into Information Technology did not begin with a traditional Computer Science education. I graduated from Darbi College Sofia, where I specialized in Physics, Chemistry and Biology.
I later studied Biomedical Sciences at HAN University of Applied Sciences for one year. I left the program to begin working with servers and pursue a practical career in technology.

Through the years, I became fascinated by how quickly technology progresses. I found it difficult to concentrate on a field that did not evolve at the same pace, which drew me toward Information Technology and the constant learning it requires.

journey.detail: Graduated from Darbi College Sofia with a focus on Physics, Chemistry and Biology.
Studied at HAN University of Applied Sciences for one year.
Left university to work with servers and build practical experience in Information Technology.
Cloud infrastructure, container orchestration, automation, reliability, and DevOps practices.

about.motivation: Technology never stands still. That pace of progress—and the need to keep learning, adapting, and improving—is what keeps me engaged in this field.
